narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The ghost's money moved past yours in month {crossover_month} and stayed ahead for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {ghost_lowest_month}, the ghost's money sat at its lowest since the split, and it still had {net_worth_gap}. With nothing coming in, the ghost could hold out a shade longer, its Safety {safety_gap}.
